_README: Copy this to stripe_config.json and fill in your TEST keys. That file is gitignored, listed
in PRIVATE_FILES so the server 404s it, and blocked by tools/pre-commit even with `git add -f`.
Environment variables win over this file, so a deployment can set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY,
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and POC_PUBLIC_URL without writing a key to disk at all.
secret_key      Stripe Dashboard > Developers > API keys. Must start sk_test_ for now: a
sk_live_ key is REFUSED unless POC_ALLOW_LIVE_PAYMENTS=1 is set in the
environment, so real money is never taken by accident.
webhook_secret  Printed by `stripe listen` as whsec_..., or shown when you add a webhook
endpoint in the Dashboard. Without it payments stay off entirely — an order
that can be paid but never confirmed is worse than one that cannot be paid.
public_url      Where Stripe sends the buyer back. Must be reachable from THEIR browser, so
localhost is right for local testing and the real domain in production.
